title: Smoky Vegetable Pasta
description: A creamy pasta dish with a smoky twist, perfect for a French-inspired meal.

ingredients.name: Mixed Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as cherry tomatoes, bell peppers, and onions

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the yellow pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the smoky Italian olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Stir in the vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil and grated Parmesan cheese.
